inputs.prompt:
Render ONE continuous 12.0-second video with four distinct full-screen shots in the exact time-coded order below. Use hard editorial cuts. Never create a storyboard grid, split screen or dissolve.

Visual references and strict roles: <Picture 1> is the exact opening frame, showing the Paris secondhand bookstore street that Claire walks into; begin on this composition. <Picture 2> is Claire's identity, face, hair, body proportions and outfit. <Picture 3> is the confirmed bookstore facade environment that must remain unchanged. Maintain one consistent hand-drawn 2D illustration style with fine dark linework, matte muted colors and quiet Paris daylight. Claire always has long dark wavy hair, gray striped sweater, headphones and backpack. No other characters, no wardrobe swaps, face redesign, photorealism, 3D, readable text, subtitles, logos, extra limbs or extra fingers.

01 | 00.0-2.0s | Side full shot: Claire walks alone along the Paris street toward the bookshop, keep the storefront composition stable.
CUT.
02 | 2.0-5.0s | Front medium shot of the dark-green bookshop facade from <Picture 3>; Claire reaches the door and pushes it open, a faint piano melody drifting out.
CUT.
03 | 5.0-8.5s | Interior medium-wide: Claire steps inside among tall bookshelves, stops and tilts her head toward the music, dust in the light.
CUT.
04 | 8.5-12.0s | Medium-close on Claire listening, eyes softening as she recognizes the melody; she takes one more step inward. No dialogue.

Keep each shot's main action clear and singular; preserve chronological order and screen direction. Candidate audio only: quiet Paris street ambience, a door chime, a faint distant piano motif. No intelligible speech.
